messages.subject: Error bar uneval
parts:
Hi,

I have been trying to find an earlier post on the same error but could
not find anything useful to my particular problem. I am trying to plot
two light curves in ggplot along with the corresponding error bars for
which I have a list as well. The error I keep getting is the following
-

Error in geom_errorbar(limits_y) + geom_errorbarh(limits_x) :
non-numeric argument to binary operator

my limits are the following

limits_x = aes(xmax = q + e_x, xmin = q - e_x)
limits_y = aes(ymax = w + e_y, ymin = w - e_y)

Following is some of the checks I did -

> mode(q)
[1] "numeric"
> mode(w)
[1] "numeric"
> mode(e_y)
[1] "numeric"



> class(limits)
[1] "function"
> class(limits_x
+ )
[1] "uneval"
> limits_
Error: object 'limits_' not found
> limits_x
List of 2
$ xmax: language q + e_x
$ xmin: language q - e_x



Any help will be much appreciated!
Nitish
